candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is ANCA-associated vasculitis (AAV), which encompasses MPO-ANCA or PR3-ANCA mediated small vessel vasculitis. Anti-GBM disease (Goodpasture syndrome) is a related but serologically and pathologically distinct cause of pulmonary-renal syndrome. The clinical record shows cavitating peripheral consolidations and multifocal pneumonia with AKI, which is more characteristic of AAV than anti-GBM disease. While both are in the pulmonary-renal syndrome family, asserting anti-GBM disease as the diagnosis conflicts with the ANCA-associated vasculitis reference at the subtype/etiology level.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Anti-GBM disease is a distinct pulmonary-renal syndrome caused by anti-glomerular basement membrane antibodies, not ANCA-associated vasculitis; both can present with pulmonary-renal syndrome but are separate diagnostic entities with different etiologies and serologies

case_quality_flags: Table 2 referenced but not provided; ANCA/anti-GBM serology results unavailable for full confirmation
Post-COVID-19 context may suggest AAV trigger but is not definitive without serology
